methodology: Reconstructs the exact pre-draw v162 threshold40 pool route. Ticket-ranking formulas use only each draw pre-draw c12 rank score, pair-affinity feature, graph-rank quality and stability. Formulas are selected solely on 2021-2022, then frozen before opening 2023-2024 and 2025-latest. The 8-number pool is unchanged. Goal: test whether compressed 1/2/3/5/10 EUR portfolios can retain v162 full hits without using post-2022 results for ticket-order selection.
